sanskrit_verse:
उपस्थानं ततः कुर्यात् सं मा सिंचन्त्वनेन तु ।
मधुमांसाशने कार्यः कृच्छ्रः शेषव्रतानि च ॥३-२८२
transliteration: upasthānaṃ tataḥ kuryāt saṃ mā siṃcantv anena tu | madhumāṃsāśane kāryaḥ kṛcchraḥ śeṣavratāni ca ||3.282||
sph_interpretive_translation: Thereafter, one should perform service; let them not sprinkle anything with this. In the case of consuming honey or meat, the prescribed action is the Kṛcchra penance and the remaining Vratas.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through disciplined adherence to sequential ritual acts.
Causation arises from conscious choice and consumption patterns.
Capacity-based responsibility requires proportional energetic purification.
Restoration logic operates through completion of specific experiential sequences.
Consciousness alignment necessitates precise vibrational rectification.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent consumes honey OR meat THEN assign Kṛcchra observance AND residual Vrata completion.
IF sprinkling occurs BEFORE upasthana THEN invalidate procedural sequence.
IF violation detected THEN initiate consciousness-resonant corrective protocol.
IF capacity deficit observed THEN defer execution until energetic recalibration.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies in the volitional act of consumption. The authority to restore balance resides in executing the precise dharmic sequence. Retribution has no place; restoration through structured observances aligns individual consciousness with cosmic order.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that ingestion alters pranic vibration. Anupūrvaśaḥ mandates a reverse causal sequence through Kṛcchra. Proportional responsibility is calibrated by energetic impact. Non-punitive reality rule confirms suffering is not justice—completion is liberation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Kṛcchra vrata observance to recalibrate sensory engagement.
Execute Śeṣa-vrata integration to restore sequential dharma flow.
Deploy prana-shuddhi protocols aligned with Madhu-Māṃsa typology.
Verify consciousness resonance post-completion before reintegration.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores reality's non-punitive basis. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Dharma prevails.
